verdict.rationale: Bento is a hosted observability and trace platform for AI agents, so choosing data region or residency is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions regions, residency or storage location. The OTel export docs describe a single endpoint with one auth header, with no regional options documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
